Scope for dispatch = **half 1 only**: add the package-internal non-README markdown surface to `SCAN_ROOTS` (entry price measured at 1 dead link, which the same PR fixes — `TIMELINE.md:349`), excluding generated `CHANGELOG.md`. Half 2 (generalising backtick in-repo path checking beyond `skills/**`) is explicitly **not** in scope — it needs its own measurement and card per the one-expansion-one-card precedent chain the body cites; leave it recorded here until someone prices it. Size/model suggestion: S-mechanical, sonnet.

Disjoint from open PRs #5988 / #5989 / #5991 / #5995 and from co-dispatched R9 cards #5754 (a new workflow), #4964 (i18n gate), #4991 (`packages/cli` test), #4996 (shadcn patches). ⚠️ **#5754 is adding a workflow this round — ⛔ do not add one here**, and ⛔ do not touch `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`; one inventory write per round and it is theirs.

## PM-verified premise on `origin/main` @ `53dc89db8`

`scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` scans the surfaces listed in its `SCAN_ROOTS` (declared at its `:4` docblock). The card measures **15 package-internal non-README markdown files that no gate has ever parsed**, with **1 confirmed dead link** among them.

⚠️ **Read that file's docblock before changing anything.** It carries a long history of this exact surface being grown deliberately — #3536, #3490, #3486 — including a case where `examples/hello-world/README.md` pointed at directories deleted in another PR. The scan surface has been widened before, on purpose, with reasons recorded. Yours must join that record, not overwrite it.

## Zone 2 — the risk that actually matters here

⚠️ **Widening a scan surface exposes every dead link on it, not the one the card measured.** 15 files have never been parsed. The card's "1 measured" is a floor, ⛔ not a scope.

So the first thing to report is: **how many dead links does the widened surface actually find?** Then, per link, either fix it or exclude it with a **measured written reason** — and ⛔ never exclude a whole file to avoid fixing one link. If the count is large enough that fixing them all exceeds this card, **clear what you can and name exactly what you left**, the same partial-delivery rule that let four `#5174` batches land.

⛔ Do not narrow the gate's strictness to make the new surface pass. Weakening is maintainer-floor — stop and report.

## Gates

Derive from your diff. At minimum `check-doc-links.mjs` itself over the whole repo (before/after counts), its test if one exists, `pnpm type-check:scripts`, Lint. Note the sibling `Internal Docs Link Check` and `Docs Links` workflows both run this family — say which your change affects. Run `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, follow its verdict; ⛔ no `skip-changeset` label (#4912/#3724).

⚠️ Restore idiom (objectstack#11648): use `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`, prove with `git diff HEAD` — the bare form reads the mutation back and exits 0.

Draft PR, `Fixes #4938`, report as an issue comment with the `<!-- os-dev-report -->` marker (⚠️ sanitizer strips it — read back, repost as literal text if so). Report the before/after dead-link count.

## ACCEPT — PR #6029. Landing on CI convergence.

Reviewer of record: `domain:devx` @ objectui seat (#5748), round **R9**, PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`. Scope: 4 files.

### The "1 is a floor, not a scope" warning came back benign — and that is a result

The dispatch's main worry was that widening a never-parsed surface would expose far more than the one measured dead link. **It exposed exactly one**, and it was fixed in the same PR:

`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/TIMELINE.md:349` → `../../examples/prototype/src/App.tsx`, an example app deleted in `3aa84cee0`.

Verified independently: that path is **absent** from `origin/main`, and the **control** — `examples/` itself still exists with live entries — makes the empty result a reading rather than a broken query. Repointed at the live docs-site demo for the same content, ⛔ not deleted.

Roots 13 → 15; `0 broken` before, `1 broken` at the widened surface pre-fix, `0 broken` after. The before/after triple is what makes this a measurement.

### The bug it caught in its own work

`pnpm type-check:scripts` caught it writing `packages/*/README.md` **literally inside a `/** */` JSDoc block** — the `*/` substring closes the comment early. ⚠️ The file's own header already warns about exactly that hazard. Fixed by rephrasing. Worth recording: the gate caught the author of a gate falling into the trap the gate's own docs describe.

### The new blind spot is disclosed, measured, and filed — ⛔ not hidden

The new `packages/*` / `apps/*` rows exclude `README.md` **at every walk depth** (to avoid re-judging the existing top-level README row). That leaves **4 nested READMEs** unscanned by any gate — `core/src/adapters/`, `components/src/__tests__/`, `plugin-gantt/docs/verification/`, `types/src/zod/` — filed as **#6026** with the entry price measured: **0 dead links today**.

⚠️ Accepting, with a note for whoever takes #6026: a **depth-aware** exclusion (skip only the row's top-level README) would have closed this entirely rather than trading one blind spot for a smaller one. The basename-at-any-depth rule is simpler and its cost is zero today — but the simpler rule is why the gap exists, and that is the thing to weigh, not the four files.

⛔ Correctly did **not** add a workflow or touch `ci-cd-pipeline.md` — #5754 owned that write this round.

### Changeset

`check-changeset-presence.mjs` flagged `TIMELINE.md` as guarded `@object-ui/components` source; an empty-frontmatter changeset was added **because the gate demanded one**, not by convention. Correct direction.

### Landing

`scripts/**`, `packages/components/src/**` (a `.md`), `.changeset/**` — **not** governed surface. Maintainer's ruling, 2026-08-24, verbatim: 「授权 auto-merge（推荐）」 — every check green, ⛔ not the `required` subset.
